description:
Snakes flick their tongues to smell in stereo. Each forked tip collects scent molecules and delivers them to the Jacobson's organ in the roof of the mouth, telling the snake exactly which direction the smell came from. That's how snakes track prey in total darkness.

OTIS — dumb questions, wild answers about animal behaviour.
